purpose: Donner aux scènes de dialogue et cinématiques une grammaire commune au gameplay, au blocking et à la caméra.

camera_moves.static: default when actor movement carries scene
camera_moves.pan: reassign attention or follow meaningful crossing
camera_moves.tilt: reveal vertical information or status change
camera_moves.dolly_in: commit to realization, threat or intimacy
camera_moves.dolly_out: isolate, reveal consequence or reduce certainty
camera_moves.truck: change relationship geometry or reveal occluded information
camera_moves.handheld_like: rare instability; never generic drama filter
camera_moves.cut: change point of view, information or dramatic beat

lens_intent.wide_context: use environment and distance, avoid distortion as spectacle
lens_intent.long_isolation: compress relationships or observe from emotional distance

composition.power: height and frame dominance may express status but must follow blocking
composition.occlusion: use architecture, shield, doorways or foreground only when meaningful
composition.lines: Ashlands structures should guide attention without turning every frame into symmetry
composition.look_room: preserve until a deliberate discomfort or unseen-presence moment

editing.reaction_priority: stay on listener when listening changes the scene
editing.silence: allow pre-line and post-line holds when a thought lands
editing.pace: derive from scene pressure, not a fixed cinematic tempo
editing.continuity: track eyeline, prop hand, weapon side, body orientation and travel direction

lighting.rule: support readability and dramatic focus without changing established Art Bible family
lighting.warm_cold: lantern amber versus cold ash fill may articulate belonging versus exposure
lighting.faces: never sacrifice readable values merely to make scene darker
lighting.motivation: light sources stay spatially motivated unless an explicit surreal event overrides them

sound.prelap: may lead a cut when next space or memory is already affecting character
sound.silence: may be authored as an event, not absence of design
sound.foley: armor, cloth, breath, grip and steps must support physical acting
sound.music: must not tell the player an emotion the performance contradicts without narrative intent

gameplay_handoff.before_cinematic: capture player-facing state, party positions and active threats
gameplay_handoff.during: lock only controls necessary for readability
gameplay_handoff.after: restore control on a readable camera, navigable space and valid gameplay state

review_questions: Can the scene's relationship be understood muted?
Does every camera move have a sentence-length reason?
Would removing half the gestures make the performance stronger?
Does the listener visibly receive information before replying?
Do body, voice and camera agree or contradict for a clear subtextual reason?
Can the player understand where control returns?
